subject.title: Fix subagent announce restart recovery cascade

question: Should announce recovery classification reserve the public announce: idempotency-key prefix, or should it persist a trusted internal announce marker that public callers cannot spoof?
rationale: agent.idempotencyKey is a public gateway protocol field, and choosing rejection/reservation versus a new trusted lifecycle marker affects API compatibility and the recovery security boundary.

options.title: Persist a trusted announce marker
options.body: Classify announce recovery from internal subagent handoff state rather than from a caller-controlled run-id prefix, preserving public idempotency-key compatibility.

options.title: Reserve announce: for internal callers
options.body: Reject or fail closed for non-internal agent requests using the announce: prefix, which is simpler but intentionally narrows a public string namespace.

options.title: Pause the PR
options.body: Hold the branch until a recovery-state owner chooses the durable marker and prefix policy.

recommendation.title: Persist a trusted announce marker
recommendation.body: Classify announce recovery from internal subagent handoff state rather than from a caller-controlled run-id prefix, preserving public idempotency-key compatibility.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice is centered on restart recovery lifecycle state and persisted session semantics.
